name: How long does it take to complete wheelchair accessible home modifications?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to complete wheelchair accessible home modifications?

acceptedAnswer.text: The timeline for wheelchair accessible home modifications depends on the project's complexity and scope. Simple installations like grab bars or a single ramp might take a few days. More extensive projects, such as a full bathroom remodel for a roll-in shower or widening multiple doorways, could take several weeks to a few months, especially if permitting is required. We provide a detailed project schedule after the initial assessment and design phase.
acceptedAnswer.description: Timelines vary: simple modifications take days, while complex projects like bathroom remodels can take weeks to months, depending on scope and permits.
